## Change

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Android build passes
- [ ] Relevant behavior was tested or is explicitly marked unvalidated
- [ ] No prototype behavior is presented as production-qualified

## Documentation sync

- [ ] README and/or `docs/` updated in the same change
- [ ] `docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md` still reflects the actual implementation state
- [ ] UI preview state updated if the visible interface changed
